safety.ui_utils: Only the exact escHtml and normalizeHexColor function source and DEFAULT_TAG_COLOR are evaluated; the ui-utils module and its imports are not loaded.
safety.vm_globals: Native language builtins, instrumented Intl, inert fake document, structuredClone, capture-only console. No process, require, fetch, timers, filesystem or network interfaces are provided to product modules.

not_run.reason: No native application/browser/WebView launch under current lockout safety scope. Generated markup equality is not pixel/layout/accessibility/live-event proof.
Existing browser/native harnesses may launch applications or servers and are excluded.
Existing test-summary-preferences.mjs imports settings-model and its UI graph. The pure normalizeSummaryPreferences contract is tested separately; Store integration is not executed.
Cargo, native execution, real data and Outlook are outside the authorized offline scope.
